competitor-brief: Compare competitors’ organic search visibility or investigate what buyers say about them in recent public discussions. Use for a one-off comparison, a recurring brief or a change against a prior snapshot.
growth-teardown: Trace how a product attracts or activates users from public evidence. Use to explain an acquisition channel, compare growth mechanisms, or adapt one into an experiment for a particular team.
job-shortlist: Find or compare current vacancies for a particular candidate. Screen employers’ postings against the candidate’s constraints and verify the application route when they want roles they can apply to now.
ugc-teardown: Analyze an ecommerce TikTok, Reel or Short, assess its performance against comparable posts, or adapt a creative idea into a shootable short-video script.
